text:
Maya (AE): quick heads-up — TelosOne exec asked for guaranteed 50 rps sustained + p95 < 200ms for their POC. they want committed capacity + a 20% discount tied to SLOs. need exec alignment today.
Jordan (SE): do we have a recommended config for 50 rps@200ms? which model family are they running (chat vs completion)?
Maya (AE): they're planning a short chat flow (context ~1024 tokens), estimates 12k tokens/day during POC. prefer 2-pass reranking on some queries.
Priya (Solutions): probably Dedicated with autoscale pinned to a min pool. rough starting config: 4xA10 (or equivalent) with batching and prefix cache. should hit throughput but latency depends on kernel path + kv cache.
Marco (Infra): heads-up — eu-west1 GPU quota limited this week. to guarantee 50 rps we may need to route some capacity to europe-north1 or enable burst in hosted fleet. that needs approval from infra budget owners.
Jordan (SE): if they accept a quantized variant (int8) of the model and we enable KV prefix caching, we can shave about ~30% latency. can we surface that as a tradeoff to TelosOne?
Maya (AE): yes please — they care more about cost/latency than model fidelity for POC. also they asked about data retention: 30-day logs, no retention beyond that, and a SOC2 addendum.
Sam (GC): legal needs the draft addendum text. I can do a quick redline but need the exact retention and access terms. also they requested IP indemnity tweaks — might be sticky.
Lena (Sales Ops): discount request (20%) + committed monthly spend (~$75k) — need revenue leadership signoff. Maya, can you confirm term length?
Maya (AE): POC is 3 months, then potential enterprise roll if SLOs met. customer wants discount applied during the 3mo POC.
Lena (Sales Ops): tagging execs for approval — can we convert discount to a commit tier vs %? easier to operationalize.
eng-deploy-bot: Meeting created: TelosOne POC technical sync — Wed 10:30am CET. Calendar invites sent to Maya, Jordan, Priya, Marco, Sam, Lena.
Jordan (SE): technical ask for infra: we need the following to validate perf in our lab before customer test:
```
- model_variant: chat-v1-quant-int8
- min_pool_gpus: 4
- target_qps: 50
- p95_target_ms: 200
- kv_cache_prefix: enabled
- batch_timeout_ms: 8
```
Priya (Solutions): can we carve a canary on dedicated with fallback to hosted low-latency instance? will mitigate cold-starts if dedicated hits issues.
Marco (Infra): canary OK but requires a HA routing policy and rule to failover by latency. ops can build that but ETA ~48h. EU quota escalation filed (case# 89271).
Sam (GC): I'll draft a SOC2 addendum and retention clause template by EOD. need Maya to confirm exact log types and retention windows (30 days, delete on termination).
Maya (AE): confirmed: logs = request metadata + tokens (redacted per PII policy), retention 30 days, auto-delete on contract end.
Lena (Sales Ops): quick ask for execs — is there appetite to approve a revenue-conditional 20% discount for 3 months with a $75k commit? pinging VP Sales for signoff.
Jordan (SE): blockers to delivery: eu-west1 quota, model quantization acceptance, legal addendum. technical mitigation: run perf test in eu-north1 and schedule failover routing.
Priya (Solutions): I'll produce a cost estimate: dedicated baseline + quantized variant savings + fallback hosted delta. should have numbers in ~3 hours.
Maya (AE): customer will sign a LOI if we can guarantee throughput and delivery timeline. they want public commitment on timeline in the next 24h.
Marco (Infra): escalated quota to priority. if approved, we can allocate by tomorrow noon. otherwise plan B is hybrid routing.
Sam (GC): uploaded initial addendum draft to Drive: https://drive.redwood.example/telosone-soc2-addendum (comments open).
Lena (Sales Ops): next steps (TL;DR):
- Sam: legal draft (EOD) ✔
- Priya: cost/ops estimate (3h) ⏳
- Marco: quota escalation (in progress) ⏳
- Jordan: perf config & verification plan (tomorrow) ⏳
- Maya: confirm LOI text + customer expectation (ASAP) ⏳
- VP Sales: discount/commit approval (pending) ⚠️
Maya (AE): thanks team — I'm looping in VP Sales and the TelosOne CTO. will post updates here after the exec call.
Jordan (SE): I'll queue a lab perf run as soon as infra confirms region. will post benchmark (p95, p50, tokens/s).
Lena (Sales Ops): adding this thread to the exec escalation board. escalate if VP Sales not responsive in 6h.
Maya (AE): final — customer asks that we include a rollback clause in the contract if p95 > 300ms for two consecutive weeks during POC. legal, pls note.
Sam (GC): noted — will include rollback language and acceptance tests in the addendum.
Maya (AE): thanks everyone. keeping thread open for updates.
